violations.why: The ISR can update v_cedar between the range check and the value passed to fn_willow, so the checked value and the used value can differ.
The ISR can change v_cedar between the read at line 32, which is used in the comparison, and the re-read at line 54 in fn_dune. The branch decision and the later check can then be inconsistent.
The task initializes v_cedar, the ISR overwrites it, and the task then reads it at line 69. The task gets the ISR's value instead of the one it wrote.
The ISR can change v_cedar between the task's two reads, at line 69 (copied to v_harbor) and at line 30 (the check). The two reads can then see different values.
